title: Scope.
partHeading: PART 6. RULES OF CONSTRUCTION APPLICABLE ONLY TO WILLS
bodyText:
PART 6. RULES OF CONSTRUCTION APPLICABLE ONLY TO WILLS

In the absence of a finding of a contrary intention, the rules of construction in this part control the construction of a will.
bodyHtml:
PART 6.  RULES OF CONSTRUCTION APPLICABLE ONLY TO WILLS

 

     §560:2-601  Scope.  In the absence of a finding of a contrary intention, the rules of construction in this part control the construction of a will. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1]
